_comment: Permissions for the magik-idle-stop Lambda role.
Attach ALONGSIDE the AWS-managed AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole (CloudWatch Logs).
StopInstances is scoped to the single demo instance. CloudWatch and SSM ListCommands
reads require a wildcard resource (neither GetMetricStatistics nor ListCommands
supports resource-level scoping), but both are read-only.
GetParameter IS scoped to the single github_actions_pat parameter -- this
role must not be able to read any other secret in Parameter Store.
